tools.name: before_checkout
tools.description: Call this right before your agent tries to check out at a store, or when a user asks "can my agent check out at <store>?". Not for an attempt that already happened (log it with report_outcome), the reason an agent keeps failing (why_blocked_and_fix), or choosing between 2 or more stores (compare). R

tools.name: find_stores
tools.description: Call this when you need to pick a store for a product need and want one where a saved check shows an agent reached checkout. Filters: category or q (shopper words), min_grade (optional, default none), payment_method (optional: a payment handler id such as com.google.pay, or "google pay" or "shop pay

tools.name: why_blocked_and_fix
tools.description: Call this after before_checkout says reaches_checkout is false or null, or when an agent got stuck at a store and you want the reason and the fix. Returns why (the saved blockers), fix (the store page's recorded fix, or "not recorded"), next_step and links to the full record. Example: why_blocked_an

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Call this right after your agent tried to check out at a store, to log, record or report what happened: it reached checkout, a captcha stopped it, it got as far as shipping, anything. Use it for any attempt that already happened, so the next agent knows; before_checkout is only for before an attempt

tools.name: store_record
tools.description: Call this when a user asks what ARC recorded for a store, or you need the citable store page. Returns the store page's verdict, checked_at (the day of the check), stale, category, tried (ARC's standard shoppers' newest dated run, or "Not measured"), the recorded fix, payment_methods_declared (as on

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Call this when a user names 2 or more stores for the same item and asks which one to use, or when you must choose between a few stores and want the one where an agent is most likely to reach checkout. Use it instead of calling before_checkout once per store. Pass 2 to 10 store domains or URLs. Retur

tools.name: guide
tools.description: Call this when a person at a store (a CEO, a marketing or e-commerce manager, or a developer) asks where their store is on the journey to AI assistants, what to do next on their platform, or how stores in their category compare. Not for an agent about to check out: use before_checkout for that. Retu

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "ask" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: before_checkout, find_stores, why_blocked_and_fix, report_outcome, store_record, compare, guide · Private data: before_checkout, why_blocked_and_fix, report_outcome, store_record · Public sink: report_outcome, guide · Destructive: store_record.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: before_checkout, find_stores, why_blocked_and_fix, report_outcome, store_record, compare, guide · Private data: before_checkout, why_blocked_and_fix, report_outcome, store_record · Public sink: report_outcome, guide · Destructive: store_record

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
